docs.title: TalentLens
docs.text: TalentLens is a multi-agent resume screening system. It parses resumes and job descriptions, verifies companies and certifications, and scores candidates with eleven persona agents that deliberate before a weighted consensus. Source: https://github.com/rakshith-ponnappa/talentlens

docs.title: AKS landing zone template
docs.text: He built a Terraform landing zone vending template for Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) with private clusters, workload identity, Azure Policy and GitOps bootstrapping through Flux.

docs.title: Jenkins Kubernetes pipeline lab
docs.text: A hands-on lab running Jenkins agents as Kubernetes pods, with declarative pipelines, ephemeral build agents and Helm based deployment to a kind cluster.

docs.title: GitLab Omnibus upgrade playbook
docs.text: An Ansible playbook that upgrades GitLab Omnibus along the supported upgrade path with backups, background migration checks and rollback notes.

docs.title: Résumé
docs.text: Rakshith S P is a cloud and platform engineer at Ensono working on Azure landing zones, Terraform, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines and site reliability engineering for enterprise customers.

docs.title: Local RAG agent platform
docs.text: A local retrieval augmented generation platform that indexes documents with embeddings, runs open weight LLM models on a workstation GPU and exposes an agent API with tool calling.

docs.title: Agentic paper trader
docs.text: An agentic paper trading bot that combines market data, news sentiment and risk rules, executing simulated orders only and logging every decision for review.

docs.title: Bhagamandala house 3D
docs.text: A three.js walkthrough of a planned family house in Bhagamandala, generated from floor plans with parametric walls, roof and lighting.
